verdict.rationale: Sentry publishes a live llms.txt (probe confirmed HTTP 200 with structured docs summary) and also offers agent-oriented setup instructions ('One command teaches Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Grok how to install and configure Sentry') plus an official MCP server for agent interaction. This directly satisfies the story of pointing an agent at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: independent/community confirmation that agents successfully consume llms.txt in practice.
